_comment: Copy to tokenomics.json and edit. This feeds the off-chain metadata JSON (upload-metadata.js) that wallets/explorers/DEXes display. Keep it accurate - mismatched or missing fields are a top reason legitimate-effort tokens get flagged as low-effort or scam.
name: Example Memecoin
description: One or two honest sentences about what this token is and is not. Do not claim utility, returns, or partnerships that don't exist.

supplyAllocation._comment: Document where every token goes. 100% to the LP at launch (fair-launch style) is the single strongest trust signal a new memecoin can give - it means no pre-sale allocation for the deployer to dump. If you deviate from that, disclose the split publicly before launch, not after.

creatorCommitments._comment: What revoke-authorities.js and the LP guide will actually do - fill in true/false honestly and then do it, since these are externally verifiable on-chain and on Solscan/RugCheck within minutes of launch.
